violation_type.title: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970 (26 TAC §746.311(b))
violation_type.short_title: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation still needs to provide notification to Licensing that the parents of all children enrolled at the operation have been notified regarding the safe sleep deficiency.

finding_variants.text: The operation still needs to provide notification to Licensing that the parents of all children enrolled at the operation have been notified regarding the safe sleep deficiency.
The operation didn't notify the parents of all children enrolled at the operation  within the required notification time.
The operation failed to timely notify the parents of being cited for safe sleep.
The operation did not notify the parents of the safe sleep deficiency by using Form 2970, Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency.
